title: cert.rs cycle detection via HashSet<Vec<u8>> of DER-encoded subjects is correct and necessary
description: validate_chain() maintains a HashSet<Vec<u8>> of DER-encoded subject names. A contributor might suggest removing this to simplify the code, or using a counter instead. The HashSet is necessary: without it, a malicious cert bag containing A signed by B and B signed by A would cause an infinite loop (or hit MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH with a misleading TooDeep error instead of the Cycle error). The DER encoding correctly handles Unicode DN normalization issues.
